Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1903); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis; the archive.org record gives the title without a volume number; the volume is identified by its own title page ('TOMUS VIGESIMUS SECUNDUS')

Content note: Councils of 1166-1225. The Fourth Lateran Council (1215) from about OCR line 92779 ('CONCILIUM LATERANENSE IV'); its constitutions from about 95626 ('I. De fide Catholica.
